question:
Select the correct spelling to fill in the blank.

Definitions of _______ are subjective to various interpretations.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sovereignty"** means supreme power or authority; it can also refer to the authority of a state to govern itself or another state. (संप्रभुता)

 
 
• **Example: **The country struggled to maintain its sovereignty in the face of external pressures.
 
 
 
• **"Sovereignty" **refers to the full right and power of a governing body to govern itself without any interference from outside sources or bodies. (संप्रभुता)
 
 
• **Example: **The sovereignty of the nation was a key point of discussion at the international conference.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Suvereignty **(अमान्य शब्द): This is an incorrect spelling and does not have a specific meaning.
 
• **Sovereinity **(अमान्य शब्द): This is an incorrect spelling and does not have a specific meaning.
 
• **Sovereinty** (अमान्य शब्द): This is an incorrect spelling and does not have a specific meaning.
